scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare: the scored output contains only the energy orderings (not raw DFT energies); these are fixed deterministic orders described in the paper and are verified by exact match of the two arrays.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold ordering arrays for adsorption sites and configurations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper: 'The energies increase in the sequence hcp, fcc, bridge, and on-top sites' and configuration III most favourable (Zn-polar O-terminated) per total energies.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's text and confirmed by the reference solve.sh
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: the gold matches the paper's reported results exactly; the ordering is the key finding.

outputs.description: Reproduces the paper's DFT energy ordering results: the most stable adsorption site for Zn/O on Au(111) (hcp) and the most stable initial ZnO configuration (Zn-polar O-terminated, configuration III).
